name: Drop Rivals
storyline: Marbles from all over a hand-painted autumn world gather to race: through golden valleys, forests, cloud islands, a lighthouse coast, a twilight town, a glacier and an orbital station. Each one is cheered on by its own pet, waiting at the finish line. Every day, the bravest attempt the Windmill Marathon, a single run through every world that ends on a red carpet.
summary: Drop Rivals is a free marble-racing game played in the web browser. Up to 30 marbles race down hand-painted tracks with windmills, spiked maces, magnetic ceilings and upside-down loops. Players can jump and dive to avoid obstacles, take part in a daily marathon with one attempt per day, customize their marble with hats, goggles, scarves and trails, and care for a pet between races. After each race, players can share a challenge link so others can try to beat their time on the same track. Online races support up to 8 players, with the remaining places filled by bots.
